units: CSS px of original browser render

safe_area_scenarios.landscape: same simulated inset on all four sides
safe_area_scenarios.native_insets: Preview is a simulation. Production adapters must merge actual platform insets and virtual-keyboard bounds; native adapter unrun.

landscape.hud: movement bottom left; survey bottom right; bag separate from minimap and movement

screens.initial_focus: Enter station after Return; Reset retains its workshop reset control; normal initial document entry uses Tab

screens.back: Cancel pending and return to title; retain form values
screens.guard: one pending request; generation token invalidates cancelled completion

screens.network: solo local fixture, no remote users

screens.guard: no survey action when a modal owns input

screens.pause: local survey paused; no multiplayer inference
screens.back: portrait detail -> selected item; otherwise close -> exact opener
screens.world_input: inert and scrim; keyboard/gamepad routed by active layer

screens.confirm: title; disconnect; progress retained in this tab

screens.back: cancel pending retry; otherwise remain and require explicit recovery choice

focus_rules.grid: spatial arrows, clamp row edges; Enter selects; Equip/Use explicit; controller X performs selected action
focus_rules.play: spatial arrow navigation among HUD controls
focus_rules.categories: Q/E or shoulder adapter; controller returns to valid selected item
focus_rules.modal: native Tab trap; Escape follows active layer; held Back cannot dismiss multiple layers
focus_rules.rotation: retain selection and drop portrait detail-only state when wide
focus_rules.comparison: inert alternate; same fixture/state, changed geometry only

evidence.visual: actual browser captures of original interface
evidence.behavior: native browser input traces and read-only snapshots
evidence.measurement: DOM rectangles; no external-game geometry measured
